description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for managing predefined book shelves in a book tracking application. It provides endpoints to retrieve books from specific predefined shelves such as 'to read', 'reading', 'read', and 'did not finish', utilizing a book service for data retrieval.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfController
classes.description: Rest controller handling HTTP GET requests related to predefined book shelves such as 'to read', 'reading', 'read', and 'did not finish', delegating data fetching to BookService.

methods.name: getAllToReadBooks
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve all books from the 'TO_READ' predefined shelf.

methods.name: getAllReadingBooks
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve all books from the 'READING' predefined shelf.

methods.name: getAllReadBooks
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve all books from the 'READ' predefined shelf.

methods.name: getAllDidNotFinishBooks
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve all books from the 'DID_NOT_FINISH' predefined shelf.
